description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled “N” and “AUC (%)” for several different lines. The x-axis, labeled “N”, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, has a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5. A purple line, marked with downward-pointing triangles, begins at approximately 83% at N=0 and decreases to approximately 80% at N=20. An orange line, marked with squares, starts at approximately 85% at N=0 and increases to approximately 93% at N=20. A blue line, marked with circles, begins at approximately 94% at N=0 and decreases to approximately 96% at N=20. A green line, marked with stars, starts at approximately 91% at N=0 and remains relatively stable at approximately 93% at N=20. A red line, marked with upward-pointing triangles, begins at approximately 88% at N=0 and increases to approximately 96% at N=10, then decreases to approximately 92% at N=20.
